title: Cute, But Has A Minor Flaw
text: Cute, But Has A Minor Flaw. I love the design and it's a decent cup especially for the price. My biggest complaint is there's a tiny hole under the trigger that managed to collect water and it's impossible to get out. Kinda makes me feel a little germy hearing it squish around with no way to get it back out entirely.
